pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena kumbhakārena bhikkhū pavāritā honti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.5: yesaṃ khuddakā pattā te mahante patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.6: yesaṃ mahantā pattā te khuddake patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.7: atha kho so kumbhakāro bhikkhūnaṃ bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.10: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessanti. -
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.11: ayaṃ imesaṃ bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.15: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.16: “atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.17: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpentīti?”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.20: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.22: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.23: “na bhikkhave patto viññāpetabbo, yo viññāpeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassāti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno patto bhinno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.2: atha kho so bhikkhu “bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ pattaṃ viññāpetunti” kukkuccāyanto na viññāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā hatthesu piṇḍāya carissanti, seyyathāpi aññatitthiyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.9: “anujānāmi bhikkhave naṭṭhapattassa vā bhinnapattassa vā pattaṃ viññāpetunti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū “bhagavatā anuññātaṃ naṭṭhapattassa vā bhinnapattassa vā pattaṃ viññāpetunti,” te appamattakenapi bhinnena appamattakenapi khaṇḍena vilikhitamattenapi bahū patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.2: atha kho so kumbhakāro bhikkhūnaṃ tatheva bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.6: ayaṃ imesaṃ bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ. attanāpi na yāpeti. puttadārāpissa kilamantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū appamattakenapi bhinnena appamattakenapi khaṇḍena vilikhitamattenapi bahū patte viññāpessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.10: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.11: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave appamattakenapi bhinnena appamattakenapi khaṇḍena vilikhitamattenapi bahū patte viññāpethā”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.14: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā appamattakenapi bhinnena appamattakenapi khaṇḍena vilikhitamattenapi bahū patte viññāpessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.17.1: “yo pana bhikkhu ūnapañcabandhanena pattena aññaṃ navaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.18: tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajitabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.19: yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo ‘ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.6: abandhano vā ekabandhano vā dvibandhano vā tibandhano vā catubandhano vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.20: sace lāmakaṃ pattaṃ adhiṭṭheti “mahagghaṃ pattaṃ gahessāmī”ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.22: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.23: “ayaṃ me bhante patto ūnapañcabandhanena pattena cetāpito nissaggiyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.28: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, gāhitāgāhitañca jāneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.31: yācitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.33: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ pattagāhāpakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.37: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pattagāhāpakassa sammuti, so tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.45: sace thero pattaṃ gaṇhāti, therassa patto dutiyassa gāhetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.46: na ca tassa anuddayatāya na gahetabbo. yo na gaṇheyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.49: yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo: “ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.50: tena bhikkhunā so patto na adese nikkhipitabbo, na abhogena bhuñjitabbo, na vissajjetabbo, ‘kathāyaṃ patto nasseyya vā vinasseyya vā bhijjeyya vā’ti.
